what: A real resumed interactive claude, in the shape gjd-remote --resume-conversation will produce, plus --model haiku to keep it cheap. Plan docs/plans/260910f, Stage 3a.
how: tmux -L s3a-sock new-session -d -s cap -c <spike dir> claude --resume <uuid> --permission-mode auto --model haiku -- "Reply with exactly: OK4"; the pane pid (1224600) was the claude itself; /proc/1224600/cmdline read and NUL-split, trailing-NUL run exactly 1; then tmux -L s3a-sock kill-server. One paid call.
why the id is not redacted: It is the spike's own scratch conversation, and the prompt is the spike's own; neither is another agent's brief. The id lives only in this file so tests/fixture-ids.test.ts never sees it in two test files.
